hunts.name: DUPLICATA marker — first vs reprint vs bypass
hunts.findings: PosReceiptPrintController atomic UPDATE + audit row + frontend marker all wired correctly. First print → newCount=1 → is_duplicata=false → 'pos.receipt.print' audit row → no marker rendered. Second print → newCount=2 → is_duplicata=true → 'pos.receipt.reprint' audit row → marker renders 'DUPLICATA #1'. Third print → newCount=3 → 'DUPLICATA #2'. Bypass mode (printing.bypass.enabled=true) does NOT bypass the counter — counter increments + audit row + marker render normally because PosReceiptPrintController is an HTTP endpoint independent of physical TCP/IP transport (the TCP/IP transport is what gets short-circuited to NullPrinterTransport, not the database write). NF525 audit chain integrity preserved in bypass mode. Sentinel: tests/js/posReceiptDuplicataMarker.spec.js.
